svg.title: The brand vision
svg.desc: STFE 2027 brand identity. Fonts: Rajdhani and Manrope (Google Fonts, SIL OFL) must be installed for correct text rendering. The STFE 2027 logo is the approved raster artwork embedded unaltered.

text.tspan: The event line from the organiser’s brochure became the
creative brief: a regional trade fair that looks and behaves
like an international one. The identity had to feel confident
and organised, yet welcoming to a first-time MSME exhibitor.
Products, brands and services in front of a B2B
Sessions with founders, experts and policy
